description: This PHP file defines a class 'AOS_InvoicesViewDetail' that extends 'ViewDetail' for rendering invoice detail views in the SuiteCRM system. It includes methods for populating invoice templates from the database, displaying a popup with template options, and handling user interactions for PDF generation related to invoices.

classes.name: AOS_InvoicesViewDetail
classes.description: A view class for displaying detailed invoice information with popup template selection in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that calls the parent constructor.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Displays the invoice detail view, populates templates, and shows popup HTML.

methods.name: populateInvoiceTemplates
methods.description: Fetches active invoice templates from the database and populates a global list.

methods.name: displayPopupHtml
methods.description: Outputs HTML and JavaScript for a popup interface to select invoice templates for PDF generation.
